mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth falls below 1% year-over-year, it signals a supply crunch that will drive inflation and compress S&P 500 margins, leading to negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY growth < 1% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate, defined as an increase of over 0.5 percentage points in 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drag on consumer spending and S&P 500 earnings, causing negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and compress S&P 500 valuations, leading to negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth falls below -10% year-over-year, it signals a severe demand slowdown that will drag on the broader economy and S&P 500 earnings, causing negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST YoY growth < -10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth falls below 100,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will drag on consumer spending and S&P 500 earnings, causing negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 100K for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures fall month-over-month for three consecutive months, it signals a consumer-led demand slowdown that will drag on S&P 500 earnings and cause negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls MoM for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: RSAFS falls MoM for 3 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3% year-over-year while the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a dangerous mix of high inflation and loose monetary policy that will lead to market instability and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
